name: Whisper small (ggml, for whisper.cpp)
blurb: Speech-to-text and transcription via Debian-main whisper.cpp - runs near real time CPU-only even on the 8 GB floor machine, and pairs with the shipped ffmpeg media utilities. 0.5 GB download, needs about 1 GB of RAM while running. Downloaded only when you click, resumable, and verified against its checksum before use.
